figurative_meaning_en: To display a threat of attack or intimidation
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিপক্ষকে শিং দেখিয়ে ভয় দেখাল।
এই ব্যবসায়ে প্রতিযোগীদের শিং দেখানো যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He showed his horns to intimidate his rival.
In this business, you can't afford to show your horns to competitors.
note: This idiom draws from the aggressive behavior of horned animals like bulls or goats in rural settings.
